reason: A remote-access integration for DeepSeek Harness that provides browser and WeChat access through LAN HTTPS or a Cloudflare tunnel, with session controls and notifications.

summaries.zh: 通过局域网 HTTPS、Cloudflare 隧道或微信机器人远程访问和控制 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Provides remote browser and WeChat access to DeepSeek Harness through LAN HTTPS or a Cloudflare tunnel, including session controls.

capabilities: Exposes DSH through a local HTTP/HTTPS server
Creates or uses a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel for public access
Generates and uses access tokens and cookies
Provides remote session and model controls through a WeChat bot
Can download and cache the cloudflared executable
Sends session completion notifications through WeChat
